第53章 大白兔奶糖被抢了-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

一家四口走在回家的路上。

太阳很好，晒得人身上暖洋洋的。

路两边的麦田已经返青了，绿油油的一片，在风里起伏着，像绿色的海浪。

林国强抱着林薇走在前面，赵素梅牵着林静跟在后面。

四个人走在村道上，影子被太阳拉得很长，投在土路上。

“爸爸！”林薇忽然又喊了一声，奶声奶气的，喊完了就咯咯地笑。

林国强笑了，低头在她脸上亲了一口：“薇薇乖。”

林静不乐意了：“爸，我也要亲！”

“好好好，也亲你。”

林国强蹲下来，在林静脸上也亲了一口。

林静满意了，蹦蹦跳跳地往前跑，嘴里喊着：“爸爸亲我了！爸爸亲我了！”

赵素梅在后面笑着喊：“慢点跑，别摔了！”

林国强站起来，看着大女儿在前面跑，小女儿在怀里笑，妻子在旁边走。

他忽然觉得，那些烦心事，好像也没那么重要了。

林美丽嫁了，就嫁了吧。

路是她自己选的，苦是她自己要去吃的。

他能做的，就是站在她身后。

等她摔倒了，扶她一把。

仅此而已。

二月中的时候，天气开始转暖了。

国强小店的生意一天比一天好。

林国强的手艺在镇上打出了名声。

不光农机厂的工人来吃，连附近几个厂的职工也绕路过来。

有时候中午忙不过来，赵志军跑得腿都细了，嘴上喊累，脸上却是笑着的。

赵素梅隔一天来店里帮半天忙，上午来，中午回去。

林静和林薇在家，托给隔壁王婶照看。

王婶人不错，心善，收了赵素梅五块钱，把两个孩子照顾得挺好。

林静跟她熟了，一口一个“王奶奶”叫着，叫得王婶眉开眼笑的。

今天赵素梅在家里洗衣服，收拾家务，就没去店里。

林静在院门口玩，林薇这会儿睡着了。

她正在晾衣服，忽然听到院门口传来林静哇哇大哭的声音。

不像是平时那种撒娇的哭。

她心里一紧，快步往院门外走去。

一出门就看见林静坐在地上，两只手撑着地，眼泪哗哗地流，小脸哭得通红。

她的头发散了，红头绳掉在地上，膝盖上蹭破了一块皮，渗出血珠子。

A family of four is walking home.

The sun is very good, making people feel warm.

The wheat fields on both sides of the road have turned green again, and are lush green, undulating in the wind, like green waves.

Lin Guoqiang walked in front holding Lin Wei, and Zhao Sumei followed behind holding Lin Jing.

Four people walked on the village road, their shadows stretched long by the sun and cast on the dirt road.

"Dad!" Lin Wei suddenly shouted again, with a milky voice, and giggled after she finished shouting.

Lin Guoqiang smiled, lowered his head and kissed her on the face: "Weiwei, be good."

Lin Jing was unhappy: "Dad, I want to kiss you too!"

"Okay, okay, I'll kiss you too."

Lin Guoqiang knelt down and kissed Lin Jing on the face.

Lin Jing was satisfied and jumped forward, shouting: "Dad kissed me! Dad kissed me!"

Zhao Sumei shouted from behind with a smile: "Run slowly, don't fall!"

Lin Guoqiang stood up and watched his eldest daughter running in front, his younger daughter smiling in his arms, and his wife walking beside him.

He suddenly felt that those troublesome things didn't seem so important anymore.

If Lin Meili is married, just get married.

She has chosen the path herself, and she has to suffer the hardships herself.

All he could do was stand behind her.

When she falls, give her a hand.

That's all.

In mid-February, the weather started to get warmer.

The business of Guoqiang's store is getting better and better day by day.

Lin Guoqiang's craftsmanship has made a name for himself in the town.

Not only workers from the agricultural machinery factory come to eat, but also workers from several nearby factories also make a detour.

Sometimes he is too busy at noon, and Zhao Zhijun's legs are so thin from running that he says he is tired, but he has a smile on his face.

Zhao Sumei comes to the store every other day to help for half a day, coming in the morning and returning at noon.

Lin Jing and Lin Wei were at home, entrusted to Aunt Wang next door to take care of them.

Aunt Wang is a nice person with a kind heart. She took five yuan from Zhao Sumei and took good care of her two children.

Lin Jing became familiar with her and called her "Grandma Wang" one after another, which made Aunt Wang smile.

Today Zhao Sumei was washing clothes and doing housework at home, but did not go to the store.

Lin Jing was playing at the entrance of the courtyard, and Lin Wei fell asleep at the moment.

She was drying clothes when she suddenly heard Lin Jing crying loudly from the door of the courtyard.

It's not like the usual coquettish crying.

Her heart tightened and she walked quickly outside the courtyard gate.

As soon as she went out, she saw Lin Jing sitting on the ground, holding her hands on the ground, tears streaming down her face, her face turned red from crying.

Her hair was loose, her red headband fell to the ground, and there was a scrape of skin on her knee, with blood dripping from it.
